title: Why a task is blocked
description: Explain why a backlog task cannot be picked up — a missing or failed dependency, a dependency cycle, a gate this machine cannot run, an expired lease, an exhausted attempt ladder. Omit `id` to get every blocked task plus anything blocking the whole project (no reviewer configured, a spending cap reached, no loop running).

id.description: One task id, e.g. "t-0008". Omit for everything that is blocked.

examples: why is t-0008 not being picked up
